headline: shiiin9 advances to 17th as ARC-2 gold line rises

sections.text: 大阪公立大学 shiiin9 gained 6.25 points to reach 52.08, moving from 20th to 17th on the ARC-2 public board.
The team is now two places outside the 15 gold places, whose cutoff rose to 54.17.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
